title: Engineering report journal
prompt: Create one complete 16:9 documentary image for CAMP CENTURY. Image1 establishes the OWNER-APPROVED DRAWING STYLE ONLY: confident detailed ink and charcoal linework, restrained watercolor, paper tooth, blue-white snow, olive winter clothes, sparse rusty ochre objects. Do not copy its composition or subjects unless requested. Any additional image is FACT reference only. Match the drawing style, not a new design system. Full finished composition, large explanatory drawing, legible short English labels integrated into the scene/paper. A complete editorial engineering notebook page with a large pen-and-watercolor cutaway of a Camp Century corrugated snow arch, timber supports and ordinary prefab room, surrounded by three small, clear material sketches: corrugated metal, timber support, compacted snow. No measured construction dimensions. The subject is the published construction study. Exact readable text only: CAMP CENTURY; Construction and performance; October 1965; Snow / Timber / Corrugated metal. Integrate text naturally in document layout, no imitation official report cover or invented report identifier. Drawing occupies 80 percent. All base artwork must be CLEAN: NO yellow highlighting, NO underlines, NO marker strokes, NO selection circles, NO loupes, NO glow or animated accents baked into the image; those are added later in DaVinci Resolve. No generic three-line title card, UI, HUD, floating boxes, fake official seals/signatures/stamps, tiny filler text, placeholders, empty panels, decorative noise or burnt parchment. Use 6 percent safe margins. This is authored explanatory artwork, not an original archival record. No invented quantities, dimensions or measurement curves. No other projects or bases. Text only as explicitly specified.
